# Margate Hedges & Tree Services

> Hedge cutting and trimming in Margate, plus reduction and tree work across Cliftonville, Westbrook and Garlinge. Salt-tolerant species, TPO paperwork handled.

## Key facts

- Phone / WhatsApp: 07763 100 477
- Email: hello@margatehedges.co.uk
- Areas served: Margate, Cliftonville, Westbrook, Garlinge, Northdown, Old Town, Palm Bay, Westgate-on-Sea
- Fully insured, fixed-price quotes, nesting-season and conservation-area checks on every job.
- Not offered: hedge removal and stump grinding.

## Services

- [Hedge Cutting Margate & Thanet Coast](https://margatehedges.co.uk/services/hedge-cutting.html): Hedge cutting in Margate, Cliftonville, Westbrook and Garlinge.
- [Leylandii & Hedge Reduction Margate](https://margatehedges.co.uk/services/hedge-reduction.html): Hedge and Leylandii reduction in Margate, Cliftonville and the Thanet coast.
- [Crown Raising Margate](https://margatehedges.co.uk/services/tree/crown-raising.html): Crown raising (elevation) in Margate and across Thanet, removing lower branches for pedestrian, vehicle or building clearance.
- [Crown Reduction Margate](https://margatehedges.co.uk/services/tree/crown-reduction.html): Crown reduction in Margate and across Thanet, reducing tree height or spread by cutting back to laterals of sensible size.
- [Crown Thinning Margate](https://margatehedges.co.uk/services/tree/crown-thinning.html): Crown thinning in Margate and across Thanet, selective live-branch removal from the canopy to reduce density.
- [Deadwooding Margate](https://margatehedges.co.uk/services/tree/deadwooding.html): Deadwooding in Margate and across Thanet, removing dead, dying and diseased branches from the canopy.
- [Tree Pruning Margate](https://margatehedges.co.uk/services/tree/pruning.html): Tree pruning in Margate, Cliftonville and across Thanet.
